Some changes will kick in after a restart.
admin_page.Type the admin code. On the computer wit: Type the admin code. On the computer with the server: this page, Admins → «A code for another browser»; or in its terminal: bin/anyassistant admin-code.
admin_page.That code isn't right (or it's too old):: The code is incorrect or has expired.
Scan the code with the device's camera. With the app installed, it connects by itself; otherwise, it goes on in the browser.
No code needed: any device on your network can connect.
admin_page.If it doesn't install by itself, on Andr: If it doesn't install by itself, on Android, go to Settings → Security → Install from storage and choose AnyAssistant.crt.
admin_page.Turn on the plugin «Devices» in the sett: Turn on the plugin «Devices» in the settings to see them here.
admin_page.Name: Name
Another device already has that name.
admin_page.The room is how you say it by voice: «po: The room is how you say it by voice: «set an alarm in the kitchen». It can also be changed by voice from the device itself: «this is the kitchen's».
The one that answers on this device.
admin_page.Getting ready: keep silent near the devi: Getting ready: keep silent near the device…
It heard talking: try again in silence.
admin_page.It couldn't start the calibration. Turn: It couldn't start the calibration. Turn on the plugin «Calibration».
admin_page.A few seconds of silence measured on the: A few seconds of silence measured on the device: how it tells your voice from the room's noise.
admin_page.It is forgotten here; if it connects aga: It is forgotten here; if it connects again it is a new device.
admin_page.It is a security plugin: without it, tha: It keeps your assistant safe. If you turn it off, that protection goes away.
AnyAssistant needs it to work properly.
admin_page.It needs its packages: bin/anyassistant: It needs its packages: bin/anyassistant setup packages, then restart.
admin_page.Turn on the plugin «Voices» to teach it: Turn on the plugin «Voices» to teach it who you are.
admin_page.Nobody yet: while nobody is known, it li: Nobody yet: while nobody is known, it listens to everyone.
admin_page.It would be good to learn their voice ag: It would be good to learn their voice again on %s.
admin_page.What needs a known voice is in Settings: What needs a known voice is in Settings → Security («voice_check»). On a device you can also say «learn my voice».
admin_page.A guide shows each phrase to read, one a: A guide shows each phrase to read, one at a time.
admin_page.Stand in front of the device you talk to: Stand in front of the device you talk to most: its microphone is the one that will hear you. Then read the phrases this window shows, one at a time.
Say it to the device: «Me llamo Suvi».
admin_page.A little longer: say the whole phrase ag: A little longer: say the whole phrase again.
admin_page.When it hears you, it goes on to the nex: When it hears you, it goes on to the next one.
admin_page.Turn on the plugin «Mail (IMAP and SMTP): Turn on the plugin «Mail (IMAP and SMTP)» to add accounts besides Gmail.
admin_page.No accounts yet. Gmail doesn't go here:: No accounts yet. Gmail doesn't go here: it works through Google (gog).
admin_page.New emails get a notice, the morning sum: New emails get a notice, the morning summary counts them, and the assistant can read them and send (with your «yes»). The password is kept in the Keychain.
admin_page.an app password, if your provider has th: an app password, if your provider has them
admin_page.Plugins other people share, from a publi: Plugins other people share, from a public catalog. Every package is reviewed before it is listed. A plugin runs on this server with your permissions.
admin_page.A plugin is code that runs on this serve: A plugin is code that runs on this server with your permissions. Install it only if you trust its author. It starts off: turn it on in Plugins when you want to use it.
admin_page.Installed. It is off: turn it on in Plug: Installed. It is off: turn it on in Plugins after restarting.
admin_page.The browsers that may change all this, b: The browsers that may change all this, besides this computer itself. A device paired to talk can't.

admin_page.Themes and plugins other people share, f: Themes and plugins other people share, from a public catalog. Every package is reviewed before it is listed.
